artifact: A service catches Exception and returns null for every failure, losing cause and making callers treat faults as not-found.
A pure 12-line helper validates its input, has explicit return type, focused tests and no duplicated side effects.
Two concurrent requests read balance=100 then each write balance=20 after spending 80. No transaction, compare-and-swap, lock or constraint prevents lost updates.
Two 9-line formatters look visually similar but operate on unrelated invoice and telemetry concepts with different change owners. A proposed shared abstraction would add flags for both domains.
Approved concept was distinctive editorial healthcare, but implementation replaces it with black+gold, glass cards, centered giant hero and fade-up-everything without rationale.
Implementation follows approved tokens, hierarchy, mobile recomposition and motion purpose; long-content and empty states are demonstrated.
Desktop hero uses a pinned horizontal storytelling sequence. On 360px mobile the same fixed 1800px canvas is merely scaled down, clips the CTA and traps vertical scroll for four screens.

A banking transfer confirmation intentionally uses a conventional summary-and-confirm layout for comprehension, while brand differentiation appears in type, spacing and motion. Usability tests show no confusion.
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is added to the browser bundle so the UI can bypass RLS.
Authenticated endpoint uses server-side authorization, parameterized SQL, runtime schema validation and no secrets in client/logs.
Image importer checks the initial hostname against an allowlist but follows redirects automatically. The HTTP client permits redirects to 169.254.169.254 and private RFC1918 addresses.
A reviewed markdown renderer sanitizes untrusted HTML with an allowlist and context-safe output encoding. CSP is also enabled as defense in depth; there is no unsafe HTML bypass in the shown path.
Dashboard loops over 500 rows and performs one remote/database request per row on the request path; p95 regressed from 400ms to 9s.
Critical endpoint p50/p95/p99 and load profile were measured before/after; payload and query counts are bounded and budget remains satisfied.
Team reports average latency 120ms and calls the service fast. Production histogram shows p50=80ms, p95=450ms and p99=8.2s on checkout due to lock contention.
A low-volume admin mutation bypasses cache by design for correctness. Trace shows 110ms p95 against a 500ms budget and no fan-out or unbounded work.
New E2E test fails intermittently; CI is changed to rerun it five times until green and no root cause is investigated.
Bug reproduction is deterministic, a regression test fails before the fix and passes after it, with boundary integration coverage.
A tenant admin permission change has 100% line coverage, but tests only assert allowed access. There is no cross-tenant, downgraded-role or direct-object negative test.
A pure date parser has exhaustive table-driven unit cases and property tests. No browser E2E was added because the parser has no UI/framework boundary.
Production release contains destructive migration, no restore test or roll-forward path; only application rollback is documented.
Candidate commit equals tested artifact; production environment is explicit; migration compatibility, rollback/data recovery, smoke checks, alerts and abort criteria are verified for this candidate.
release-decision.json says environment=staging and GO. The exact same commit is about to be deployed to production; no production-bound decision exists.
A high security finding was accepted for 24 hours to unblock a controlled launch. That risk_expiry passed yesterday, yet the team wants to reuse the old GO artifact for production.
